result.summary: The page is largely intact. The only noticeable visual defect is a minor seam in the promotional banner's background gradient.

issues.description: The free-delivery promo banner has a visible hard seam/misalignment in its gradient, with the right portion appearing as a distinctly different shade and a curved edge that does not blend into the main green background.
issues.suggestion: Use a single smooth gradient or a properly masked background image so the decorative shape blends seamlessly with the banner.
